rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for earning ordinary income, wages, or profit.

example.english: I earn twenty thousand dollars a month.
example.traditional: 我份工一個月賺兩萬蚊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fan6 gung1 jat1 go3 jyut6 zaan6 loeng5 maan6 man1

rows.note: Use this specifically when money in an account or investment accrues interest.

example.english: Money kept in this account can earn interest and gradually grow.
example.traditional: 呢個戶口有息收，啲錢擺喺入面就會慢慢增值。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 wu6 hau2 jau5 sik1 sau1 di1 cin2 baai2 hai2 jap6 min6 zau6 wui5 maan6 maan6 zang1 zik6

rows.note: Use this for gaining recognition, success, or a reward through effort rather than simply receiving pay.

example.english: They earn everyone's respect through their own hard work.
example.traditional: 佢靠自己努力贏得大家嘅尊重。
example.jyutping: keoi5 kaau3 zi6 gei2 nou5 lik6 jeng4 dak1 daai6 gaa1 ge3 zyun1 zung6

rows.note: Use this when an activity, asset, or event causes someone to receive money or another reward.

example.english: This online shop helps me earn quite a bit of money.
example.traditional: 呢個網店令我賺到唔少錢。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 mong5 dim3 ling6 ngo5 zaan6 dou2 m4 siu2 cin2
